notes.title: DUSK HD + SDK Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome back once again...

Today we bring an update for all the [b]WORTHY[/b] playing DUSK in 2024.

Updates to both the [b]DUSK SDK[/b] and [b]DUSK HD[/b] (with more soon to come)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/6d53b960da829c3fa71baa864c8c85a06a1c5a13.png[/img]

The [b]DUSK SDK[/b] is getting a sizeable update today! With better Quake and Half Life map support as well as the ability to make [b]ENDLESS LEVELS[/b], fixing some major bugs and advanced music scripting!

[u][h2]New Entities[/h2][/u]
[h3]info_playlist[/h3]
Creates a music playlist. Give this entity a targetname, and assign a sequence of music tracks by setting track0, track1, and so on to music file paths.

[h3]trigger_playlist[/h3]
Activates a music playlist. Set the target to the targetname of an info_playlist entity, then trigger the trigger_playlist in order to begin playback. You can set shuffle to 1 to enable shuffling of the playlist, and loop to 1 to cause the playlist to loop. When a playlist is looping, you can use a 
trigger_changemusic trigger to stop it.

[h3]point_template[/h3]
Used for creating enemy templates that are later spawned with a trigger. Refer to the Source point_template documentation for further details. DUSK additionally supports specifying teleportfx 1 to spawn teleporter particles on each enemy spawned.

[h3]info_endless_node[/h3]
This entity will trigger its target when a new wave begins, if the current wave is greater than or equal to its first_wave property. The last_wave property can be used to disable an info_endless_node starting from a specific wave.

[h3]trigger_remove_target[/h3]
This entity will immediately delete any entities it is targeting when it is triggered. 

[code][h3]You can now create Custom endless maps by setting endless to 1 in worldspawn 

Enemy template entities also require an endless property set to 1 on them in order to be tracked as endless wave enemies [/h3][/code]
[u][h2]Fixes/Changes[/h2][/u][list]

[*]  Fixed memory leak when finishing a custom level
[*] Fixed fence texture rendering for embedded BSP textures
[*]  Game will now default to D3D11 instead of OpenGLCore
[*]  Fixed load order buttons in modding menu
[*] Fixed .ent files not being loaded
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/52f665d8c678b58564483b120302c672007da3d1.png[/img]
[h3]As for [b]DUSK HD[/b]: 

Garumin has been a busy boy! So much so [i]we've had to stop him from adding more things to DUSK HD[/i] and save them for mods on the Steam Workshop![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/adea190d8c7edef18d47b8992de2228915618175.png[/img]
[u][h2]Fixes/Changes[/h2][/u][list]

[*] Various environmental tweaks and improvements
[*]     Extensive rework of particle systems, especially blood splat
[*]     Replaced bars and ladder sprites with 3D versions
[*]      Added grass and foliage to outdoors environments
[*]      Added wide new range of objects to environments fitting their themes, such as:
[*]          Rocks and rock decals
[*]          ““““Functional”””” mirrors
[*]          Wires, cabling and electrical equipment
[*]          Drains, corrugated sheets and ground debris
[*]          Various machines, pipes and modular flanges
[*]          Tools and throwable items
[*]          Boxes, pallets and yard junk
[*]          Office supplies and mundane utilities
[*]          Military-themed props
[*]          A single pleasant ceiling fan
[*]          Piles of spent brass, to illicit a warm and inviting atmosphere
[*]          Lab equipment, including papers covered in exciting nerd stuff
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/9f1a2a764152279f7b4337fe9cb01ca28f29cc01.png[/img]

[h3]In the NOT SO DISTANT future we'll be adding all the DUSK HD assets to the DUSK SDK so you can use them in your mods as well as finally adding support for custom [b]ENEMIES and WEAPONS[/b] so [i]LOOK FORWARD TO THAT[/i].[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717300/DUSK_HD/

[h3]And don't forget we're celebrating New Blood's 10 YEAR ANNIVERSARY with a BIG SALE on all our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NewBlood/sale/newblood2024]games[/url] and [url=https://newbloodstore.com/?snr=1_1056_615_newblood2024_100730]merch[/url]. Go on, take it ːcultyː

[/h3]

TO [i]DUSK[/i] AGAIN.[/h2]

EVERY THING[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/15a0fc05965eac92f5285b466e0ea612ef84cf1d.png[/img]

notes.title: The NEW and OLD Update
notes.notes:

Normally we wouldn't post about another game platform here on Steam, but...

[b]A. [/b]It's relevant and [b]B. [/b]Check out this sick trailer we made:

[previewyoutube=mYTehPllWNk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][h3]Now why is that relevant? [/h3][/i]
Because [b]AS PROMISED[/b] we're bringing features from the Nintendo Switch version of DUSK [u]back[/u] to the PC version! And we're starting that... [b]TODAY.[/b]

[h3]WEAPON WHEEL[/h3] (Hold Q to use)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/84628526cc93fec92c3e4989bdba60c66921d9e2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Halloween 2020 Update
notes.notes:
[i][h2]INTRUDERS.[/h2][/i] 
[i]Been a minute, yes?[/i]

Well it's [b]Halloween[/b] so you know the [i]DUSK Dudes[/i] were gonna come visit ya.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QxYTbJlTl1BCSWxmTf/giphy.gif[/img]

But this year we're not [b]just[/b] bringing back Spooky DUSKWorld...

Even though we have totally done that and [b]you should play DUSKWorld with us this weekend[/b] in 

[b][url=discord.gg/newblood]OUR DISCORD.[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/9b45c461d23c92886e697e097938d3a8a4a7f2f1.jpg[/img]

We've also updated both the DUSK SDK... [b]AND THE MAIN GAME?![/b]

That's right, thanks to our work on the Nintendo Switch™ verison of DUSK ([url=https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1319821845307113473]which we just delayed, sorry[/url]) we've been making lots of performance improvements to DUSK.

[b]GOOD NEWS[/b] is that some of those improvements are making it back into the PC Version.

[h3][b]STARTING TODAY.[/b][/h3]

Loading tunes? [url=https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1321839140762054656][b]WHAT TUNES[/b][/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/d71ed4c2c7306b2165c073f846ae842080fc0ce7.png[/img]

You will now load into DUSK almost [b]instantly[/b] after the initial DOS bootup sequence. [b]YOU'RE WELCOME.[/b]

[url=https://twitter.com/DUSKdev/status/1321841543200808963]Don't ask how we did it...[/url]

([i]You can also now add a "-skip-dos" launch option to skip the FakeDOS intro screen entirely.[/i]) 

[i]But you shouldn't because it's super cool and retro.[/i]

We've also re-written the achievement manager, as it contributed to a significant performance loss.

[i][b][h3]Shorter loads. Better performance. For DUSK. In 2020. Damn right.[/h3][/b][/i]
But the [b]DUSK SDK[/b] has also gotten a host of updates!

[i]BEHOLD[/i]
[list]
[*]Heavily optimized startup code, which fixes the infamously long "loading tunes" screen.
[*]Fixed health and armor being incorrect after loading a save on a custom level.
[*]Lighting accuracy in Quake 1 BSP (v29) maps has been improved.
[*]Cartdogs no longer spawn without a model.
[*]Wendigos now correctly spawn invisible.
[*]Missing models will now display as a cube.
[*]Idle animations in custom models will now play correctly.
[*]Added a -skip-dos launch option to skip the FakeDOS intro screen.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused music (and possibly other assets) to occasionally fail to load.
[*]Significantly reduced texture allocations when atlasing lightmap data, resulting in faster map loads and better performance.
[/list]
[b][i]And YES, Custom weapons, Steam Workshop and Co-Op are still coming.[/i][/b]

In addition to that, some things we've added to the console version [b](like the weapon wheel[/b]) will be making it back to the PC Version... SOON™

[i](You can see the weapon wheel in action below)[/i]
[previewyoutube=GJ2ZtyH0cDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
However, the PC version will [b]also[/b] be getting [u][b]ALL NEW[/b][/u] features such as...

[h3]A CLASSIC HUD[/h3] 
(By the one and only HDOOMguy)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/c9390cbd81d880be60b8d25922270c6f41757b69.png[/img]

[b]Oh yes.[/b]

What, did you think we were ever even [i]close[/i] to done here?

[url=https://dusk.mod.io/]DUSKMods.com[/url] grows [i]EVERY DAY.[/i]
The [url=https://booru.newblood.games/post/list]NEW BLOOD GALLERY[/url] grows [i]EVERY DAY.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/f7fb53f3d346f05316f93dc8a605ce6a9648bb91.png[/img]

[i][b]THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.[/b][/i]

Oh, also [url=https://newblood.games/store][b]DUSK merch is back in stock.[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/b5f236a312b1b252b88b7b7dcf4dc40ab513a66c.png[/img]

Thanks as always for your support  ːleatherneckː

It's been a pretty crazy 2 years since we were [b]SUPPOSED[/b] to launch DUSK 1.0, but you have proven time and time again that you are all...

[i][h1]WORTHY[/h1][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/519860/DUSK/

notes.title: An UPDATE?!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/950713289639895509/F06413239216B642B140D2F8F18731ACE4F79BA8/[/img]

But it [b][i]IS[/i][/b] important.

As we work to put the finishing touches on the game - we've brought [i]DUSK[/i] fully into [b]Unity 2018.[/b] 

This will allow us to do much more with the game moving forward (like the Switch port) and streamline all of our processes. Huzzah! (Patch notes below)

https://steamcommunity.com/app/519860/discussions/0/1474222499229643131/

While we were doing this... 

[h1]We also made changes to the UI/UX and menu systems![/h1]

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/950713289639888849/5A912F02CD0315F7E0B76A691C04ECBDC518179A/[/img]
